requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online at any time, without needing to call or visit.
The booking process should allow customers to select a service, choose a barber, and see available time slots, all in a straightforward manner.
Customers should have a simple online method to change or cancel appointments, with a notice period of at least one day for cancellations.
Barbers should be able to set their own schedules, and the system must reflect their real-time availability to avoid double bookings.
The system should be user-friendly for both customers and staff.
The system should be mobile-friendly for optimal use on smartphones.
